steps.html:
In this tutorial you will learn to use keyboard controls to move around and make basic shots. If you don't have a physical keyboard, go to the touchscreen tutorial instead.

To begin, press the button below or just hit the N key.
First, we need to make sure you are seeing the table as you would in real life. Let's configure the simulator to match your physical height.

Experts recommend aiming shots while standing upright, before you get down into a shooting stance.  This gives you the best view of the table and avoid many optical illusions that occur when you are low to the table.
MillionBalls mimics this real-life action.  When preparing to shoot, you'll move from side-to-side around the cue ball to find the right line of aim to the object ball.
The movement controls are enabled now enabled now.  Use the left and right arrow keys to move around. Press and hold them to move faster. Tap them to make small adjustments.
Good players aim while standing up.  When they are ready to shoot they drop down into a shooting stance and place the cue directly along the line of aim.
When you are ready, press the spacebar or C to get down. Don't worry if you are unsure of the aim. We'll cover that in a future tutorial.
You can use make fine adjustments to your aim by pressing the left and right keys while down. Try it now.
It's inadvisable to make large adjustments while down in the shooting stance. Press the C key to get back up to make larger aim adjustments. Try it now.
Now, try to aim and get down on this shot to make the ball. Again, don't worry if you're unsure of the aim.  In this tutorial we're just learning the controls.
When you are ready, hit the spacebar to shoot.
When you are practicing, you can always press ? to get help with the keyboard controls. Press ? again to close it. Try it now.

Review

This concludes the tutorial on basic keyboard controls.
  • You learned to move around and aim shots while standing up.
  • You learned to fine-tune your aim
  • You learned to get back up to make large adjustments to your aim
  • You learned how to shoot a basic shot
  • You learned to bring up the help screen on keyboard shortcuts
